title: Can I add interaction prompts to my game?

posts.author: MurrayTheAwesome
posts.body: I have interactable objects in my game such as a gravestone you can read if you click on it, and books with messages in them, but I want the player to know that they are actually interactable and not just set dressing. Is there a way I can have a visual indicator that the object can in fact be interacted with. Would prefer not to use plugins but if that's what I need, then what one should I use? I have some plugins that came with the game when I bought it on steam. Could any of those help? I'm very new to RPG Maker (and game development as a whole).

You could set up parallel events on the tiles in front of the objects and have it so when a player steps on them, it displays an image.

posts.author: ISC
posts.body:
I suggest three options:
1) You can modify the graphic of a character. By creating a simple animation, you can achieve a nice effect.
2) Place an event with an existing character on a tile. That character already has the necessary animation.
3) Use the Visustella Event and Movement plugin. Check out the "label" or "icon" tag.
Events and Movement Core VisuStella MZ - Yanfly.moe Wiki
www.yanfly.moe

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Do you want the indicators to always be there or just when the player gets close?
That informs whether you use a plugin or just add it to the event graphics with an image editor.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
Indie_Goblin said:

This is a bad idea. Running that many parallel checks is incredibly unnecessary.
Imagine a library with 10 books, you'd have 10 parallel events.
